steps.message: What was the total distance covered for skiing activities in the OpenTracks app from October 06 2023 to October 11 2023? Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.

Execute: adb shell "date; settings get global time_zone; cmd package list packages | grep -i opentracks; ls -ld /data/data/*opentracks* /data/user/0/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; ls -ld /sdcard/Android/data/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; find /sdcard -maxdepth 5 -iname '*opentracks*' 2>/dev/null"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; settings get global time_zone; cmd package list packages | grep -i opentracks; ls -ld /data/data/*opentracks* /data/user/0/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; ls -ld /sdcard/Android/data/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; find /sdcard -maxdepth 5 -iname '*opentracks*' 2>/dev/null""
